test_objective: Check that you can query context source registrations matching property and relationship names of RegistrationInfo

test_cases.name: 037_06_01 Query With Matching Properties And Relationships
test_cases.template: Query Context Source Registration Matching Properties And Relationships Of RegistrationInfo
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/csourceRegistrations'
        method set to 'GET'
        Retrieve Temporal Representation of Entity and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: type set to 'Building' and
    Query Parameter: attrs set to 'name,locatedAt'
}

test_cases.name: 037_06_02 Query Without Properties And Relationships

    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:

        method set to 'GET'

    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld' and

    Query Parameter: attrs set to '${EMPTY}'
}
